relations.description: REGISTRATION REJECT message contains 5GMM cause #5 PEI not accepted.
Receiving REGISTRATION REJECT with cause #5 causes UE to enter 5GMM-DEREGISTERED.NO-SUPI state.
Procedure behavior is guarded by condition of message received over 3GPP access.
Procedure behavior is guarded by condition of message received over non-3GPP access and integrity protected.
Procedure failure establishes property of informing upper layers.
Condition of shared network establishes PLMN selection procedure.
PLMN selection procedure has step of initiating initial registration for emergency services.
PLMN selection procedure behavior is guarded by condition of equivalent PLMN.
REGISTRATION REJECT over non-3GPP access requires integrity protection.
